missions.name: Launch ICBM
missions.notes: Main mission only; not the optional objective in special Gloom missions. No additional campaign restriction encoded; this does not establish availability on every planet.

missions.name: Eradicate Automaton Forces
missions.notes: Community reference lists Easy through Super Helldive. Campaign restriction unspecified; compatible suggestion, not an exact operation listing.

missions.name: Eradicate Terminid Swarm
missions.notes: Community reference lists Easy through Super Helldive. Campaign restriction unspecified; compatible suggestion, not an exact operation listing.

missions.name: Evacuate High-Value Assets
missions.notes: Defense-only rule applies here to Terminids and Automatons. Illuminate variant is a separate confirmation-only row due to its regional exception.

missions.name: Defend Evacuation Site
missions.notes: Illuminate variant has a regional exception to the defense-only rule. Exact regional eligibility remains unresolved; require player confirmation instead of guessing.

missions.name: Retrieve Valuable Data
missions.notes: Community reference lists Medium through Super Helldive and all three fronts, including the Illuminate addition. Campaign restriction unspecified; verify the operation in-game.

missions.name: Emergency Evacuation
missions.notes: 40-minute evacuation, not the removed Retrieve Essential Personnel mission or 20-minute asset defense. Illuminate uses Evacuate Colonists instead of this identity. Campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Evacuate Colonists
missions.notes: Illuminate evacuation; the reference also calls its city variant Evacuate Citizens. One identity avoids double-weighting a renamed variant. Campaign restriction unspecified; check the actual operation.

missions.name: Blitz: Search and Destroy (Terminids)
missions.notes: Faction-specific reference lists Easy through Super Helldive; older generic Challenging minimum is not used. Campaign restriction unspecified; suggestions are not an exact operation listing.

missions.name: Blitz: Search and Destroy (Automatons)
missions.notes: Faction-specific reference lists Medium through Super Helldive. City/Megafactory presentations share one identity, not extra weighted rolls. Campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Ships
missions.notes: Normal minimum is Medium; Trivial/Easy require Avert Void operations on Exostorm planets. Void Source Planet replaces ships with gateways. Current adapter cannot distinguish these regions, so require player confirmation instead of suggesting the wrong variant.

missions.name: Rapid Acquisition
missions.notes: Confirmed identity, faction, duration and difficulty. Reference is tentative about expansion beyond the original Magma/operation context. Require player confirmation until current regional availability is independently established.

missions.name: Chart Terminid Tunnels
missions.notes: Gloom-specific mission. The current war adapter does not verify Gloom operation eligibility; confirmation-only, never unlocked by Major Order prose.

missions.name: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Gateways
missions.notes: Exclusive to the Void Source Planet; replaces regular Warp Ships Blitz there. Current adapter lacks verified regional eligibility, so require player confirmation.

missions.name: Upload Escape Pod Data
missions.notes: Main objective only at difficulties 1-2. At difficulty 3+ the reference describes an optional objective, not a separate mission roll.

missions.name: Start Fuel Pumps
missions.notes: Main objective at difficulties 1-2, formerly Pump Fuel To ICBM; do not add an alias as a second roll. Restrict suggestions to the two fronts explicitly described in the body; the broad Any infobox does not establish Illuminate availability.

missions.name: Terminate Illegal Broadcast
missions.notes: Main mission at difficulties 1-2. Higher-difficulty optional objectives, and the Easy city side-objective exception, do not create separate rollable missions.

missions.name: Spread Democracy
missions.notes: Main mission on the two fronts explicitly described in the body. Gloom/Hive World side objectives are not separate missions. Broad Any infobox is not treated as evidence for an Illuminate main mission.

missions.name: Activate Oil Pumps
missions.notes: Standalone main objective only at difficulties 2-3. Its reuse as an objective inside Enable Oil Extraction does not extend this standalone mission's range.

missions.name: Enable Oil Extraction
missions.notes: Main mission at difficulties 4-10; formerly Enable E-710 Extraction. One stable identity, not a second weighted alias. Campaign restrictions unspecified; verify the operation in-game.

missions.name: Destroy Command Bunkers
missions.notes: Main mission at difficulties 5-10. Objective count/layout variants do not create additional weighted mission identities. No assumption of exact live availability.

missions.name: Conduct Geological Survey
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: mission page gives difficulty 1-10, while the general Difficulty table introduces it at 3. Preserve the broad documented range as metadata without claiming reliable low-level eligibility. Gloom optional objectives are not separate missions.

missions.name: Eliminate Brood Commanders
missions.notes: Main mission targets, not the generic spawn range of Brood Commanders. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Eliminate Chargers
missions.notes: Medium-only main mission. Regular Charger encounters at higher levels do not extend its mission range. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Eliminate Bile Titans
missions.notes: Challenging to Hard main mission; later ambient Bile Titans are not separate missions. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Eliminate Impaler
missions.notes: Hard-only main mission, not a rule about every Impaler encounter. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Eliminate Devastators
missions.notes: Trivial to Easy main mission; do not use the regular enemy spawn range as mission eligibility. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Eliminate Automaton Hulks
missions.notes: Medium-only main mission. Optional targets in special operations are not extra standalone missions. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Eliminate Automaton Factory Strider
missions.notes: Challenging to Extreme main mission. Commando optional objectives do not add another weighted mission. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Destroy Harvesters
missions.notes: Medium-only main mission. City presentation is not a second identity; no additional regional rule established. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Destroy Transmission Network
missions.notes: Easy to Medium main mission. Higher-level optional objectives on special operations are excluded from standalone rolls. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Purge Hatcheries
missions.notes: Easy to Super Helldive main mission. Gloom optional hatcheries do not add an extra mission identity. Community-reviewed compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability; campaign restriction unspecified.

missions.name: Nuke Nursery
missions.notes: Challenging to Super Helldive main mission. City/cave presentations and multiple chambers remain one identity, not extra weighted missions. Campaign restriction unspecified; compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability.

missions.name: Sabotage Air Base
missions.notes: Medium to Super Helldive main mission. Dropship-only and control-tower layouts share one identity; city/Megafactory variants do not add separate weighted rolls. Campaign restriction unspecified; compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability.

missions.name: Neutralize Ground-to-Orbit Defenses
missions.notes: Challenging to Super Helldive main mission. Standard and Megafactory presentations share one identity. Campaign restriction unspecified; compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability.

missions.name: Sabotage Supply Bases
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: page body restricts normal operations to difficulty 1-5 with city exceptions, while August 12 change history says higher levels now appear outside cities/factories. Unresolved evidence; broad range is descriptive, not automatic eligibility. Optional stockpile/fuel objectives are not standalone missions.

missions.name: Retrieve Recon Craft Intel
missions.notes: City presentation and black-box subobjectives remain one mission. No additional campaign restriction established; compatible suggestion, not exact operation availability.

missions.name: Extract Anomalous Material
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: Void operation context cannot be established by the current adapter. Main mission only; optional extraction sites are not extra weighted missions.

missions.name: Free Colony
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: Free the City is a presentation alias, not an extra mission. Non-Void versus Democratize the Void context is unresolved in the adapter; confirm the observed operation.

missions.name: Democratize the Void
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: Void-exclusive counterpart to Free Colony; the adapter cannot establish the required regional context.

missions.name: Take Down Overship
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: City mission with documented special Quell Exostorm and Investigate Void operation exceptions. The adapter cannot determine this operation/region combination.

missions.name: Infiltrate Illuminate Lair
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: Void-exclusive mission with variable main subobjectives; do not create duplicate rows for the constituent tasks. Regional context unresolved.

missions.name: Repel Invasion Fleet
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: Requires a city defense operation. Defense restriction recorded but city operation context remains unresolved; defense alone must not enable suggestions.

missions.name: Destroy Exospire
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: Exostorm-associated mission. Current adapter has no verified Exostorm operation rule; do not infer it from planet name, biome or Major Order prose.

missions.name: Destroy Gazer Spire
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: Void-exclusive mission; regional context cannot be established by the current adapter. Spires appearing as lair subobjectives are not extra missions.

missions.name: Blitz: Suppress Toxic Pollination
missions.notes: Confirmation-only: Void-exclusive main mission. Pollination is the reviewed title; the Pollution redirect is not a separate identity. Lair blossom subobjectives do not add extra missions.
